data.materialization: Exact existing stored bytes and legal order; no new domain/teacher/labels/data, no append to original train/dev/test

training.loss: Native CPU float32 flat full-list cross_entropy; sum of 16 per-example losses divided by 16; one optimizer update after all 16 backwards
training.order: Fixed original increasing row order; no shuffle or vectorization of the reference control
training.selection: Final update1000 only; initial fit16 and final fit16/transfer144 twice, no early stop, best checkpoint, extra seed or tuning

shared.prediction: Original full-list raw argmax and first legal index on ties; no score scaling or routing

contrast.factor: scorer design: original board-conditioned spatial13292 versus pointwise outcome-only MLP769

candidate.input: Only stored candidateFeatures columns52..73, in original31-candidate order
candidate.initialization: Cold torch.nn.Linear default initialization after existing configure(seed20261008); no checkpoint load or original-CNN weight mapping
candidate.excludedInputs: No board/metadata/footprint, absolute candidate coordinates, candidate key, instance/id, label or reference score enters forward

contrast.interpretation: Architecture, context removal and capacity change together; this is a bypass/sufficiency diagnostic, not a single-component causal ablation or equal-FLOPs comparison

controls.order: Run complete exact spatial control before creating candidate model
controls.controlExact: Original initial fit logits/weights, all1000 pre-update losses/history, final logical weights, fit16 and transfer144 logits/predictions/metrics and final repeats exact; STOP on mismatch
controls.candidateInitial: Validate deterministic cold candidate shape/parameter count and finite output only; cross-architecture initial weights/logits are not expected equal
controls.candidateRepeat: Candidate final fit16/transfer144 repeated byteexact, finite weights/gradients and exact before-call ledger; no original candidate score exists
controls.noReferenceModel: Native tests use scalar/tensor/mocks only; no extra reference network/warmup/prefix forward

resources.runtime: Existing CPU PyTorch only; no install/GPU/service/external transmission
resources.failure: Reserve global/arm/phase/example before each call; STOP on source/data/control/finite/ledger/time/RSS/cancel failure, retain partial artifacts, no retry/restart/tuning

screening.comparison: Separate technical/control reproducibility, fit gate, transfer gate, paired recovered/regressed/both-correct/both-wrong; retain FAIL unless all gates pass, no new threshold or merged denominator
screening.inputEquivalence: 144/144 outcome candidate multisets already match fit16; deterministic pointwise outcome ranking sees known vectors, so even a native transfer PASS is not an independent generalization result. Floating-point metrics/order still require actual native verification
screening.limits: Prior144 is post-hoc; no new data family, action-kind, old339/89 repair, spatial mechanism, survival or app adoption claim
